body.x: Send tier-graduated Push Notifications and Internal Messages to inactive players, to re-engage them before the risk level escalates.

Applies to inactive players by days-since-last-deposit tier (1D, 3D, 7D, 14D, 30D), on both TC and Zyra platforms. This SOP owns the risk-tier segmentation and messaging. The send mechanics are the shared ones in the Push Notification SOP (34).

x: TC uploads as `.txt`, Zyra uploads as `.csv` from the BO. Wrong format fails the upload.
1D is Push only (soft reminder, no urgency, no SMS, no IM). 3D and above add SMS + Internal Message.
Player must be inactive AND not already have claimed a similar bonus this cycle.
State clearly: the offer applies to the next deposit, has a validity period, and needs 1x turnover.
SMS is sent by Retention Team Admin; VIP CS prepares the list only.
RG / chase flag beats every push. Flagged players route to welfare, no push.

Select Specific User > Firebase App Messaging, upload the `.txt`
Input subject and content, click OK
